descFull: One CLI for all your robots. Connect them, command them, and let them work together, each with an LLM for a brain (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Grok, or local via Ollama or vLLM), VLAs for arms and decision LLMs (Jev, Laya, Kev). Drives Microduck, Open Duck Mini, LeRobot, XLeRobot, AlohaMini, ToddlerBot, or any ROS 2 base from a laptop, offboard.
